comparison.objective: Set and clamp a pneumatic-cylinder slot sensor at the middle of its switching range.
comparison.physical_skill: Use a seated hex driver to drag a sensor along a slot, locate a functional band, and tighten its clamp.
comparison.success_condition: Sensor within 1 mm of band center, passes rod-cycle and 10 N push tests, hands clear, held 2 s; stripping fails.
comparison.reason: Tool-mediated sensor adjustment and clamping do not test screening or particle recovery. No material rubric detail is missing.
